capture_method: OneROM live substitution; checksum-protected RBCP; verified restoration

observation_profile.phases: NOP bit0 (+2 CCK), EXG bit1 (+3 CCK); conditional branch costs also apply; recorded brackets are authoritative
observation_profile.event_offset: delay selects prelaunch NOP/DBRA padding, not source latency
observation_profile.watchdog: disabled; request must wake STOP; bounded emulator preflight before hardware
observation_profile.units: raw VHPOSR words, register flags, absolute stacked PC; no alignment or packed-beam subtraction
observation_profile.launch: +12 pre-write beam; +14 zero (no post-write read before STOP); SR lowered immediately before CPU write
observation_profile.limitations: CPU custom write and instruction-poll recognition remain combined; no electrical IPL measurement
observation_profile.stop_guard: Handler records original stacked PC, then STOP cases resume after STOP to avoid a real-HW early-interrupt hang

repeatability: Two repetitions per condition; superseded by v5 aligned launch qualification.
uncontrolled_state: Only 112 emulator rows share launch/read brackets; do not align the remaining observations.
